description: This file defines a common base configuration and exception classes for LLM providers, including abstract methods for request transformation, response handling, environment validation, and other provider-specific behaviors. It serves as a foundational class for implementing various language model provider integrations in the project.

classes.name: BaseLLMException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to LLM provider requests, including HTTP status, headers, request, response, and body details.

classes.name: BaseConfig
classes.description: Abstract base class providing configuration utilities and abstract methods for managing LLM provider interactions, including request/response transformations, environment validation, and response formatting.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of class attributes that are not special functions or private.

methods.description: Generates a JSON schema from a Pydantic model object.

methods.description: Checks if max token limits are specified in the parameters.

methods.description: Adjusts optional parameters to include max tokens based on thinking settings.
